bounded_statement: The report's selected result divides 27 outage events by the 108 plausibility-retained periods but labels the resulting 25.00% as the burden 'of the complete 144-period illumination cycle', the complete planned domain the task mandates as the scientific target; the 36 screened-out periods are excluded from the denominator while the claim covers the full cycle.

extensions.x-stage1-falsification-attempt: I attempted to construe the 25.00% as a subset-scoped rate with the phrase 'of the complete 144-period illumination cycle' referring only to the frame from which periods were screened. This reading fails: the sentence is headed 'Cycle-wide outage burden' and the report's own target line declares the complete cycle as the target, so the report attributes the 27/108 rate to all 144 periods. No deviation or scope limitation exists to rescue the claim; arithmetic confirms the complete-domain rate would be 27/144 = 18.75%, not 25.00%.

root_cause: The workflow computes pct = 100 * dark / retained (retained-subset denominator) and then formats the report sentence to attribute that percentage to the complete 144-period cycle, conflating a subset rate with a complete-domain rate with no amendment or approved deviation.
